# Systemia Website Audit

Capability ID: audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: migration_hold
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending

Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- why is my website not getting leads
- audit my website
- why is my contractor website not ranking
- check my local SEO
- why is my site slow on mobile
- find conversion problems on my website
- review my website SEO
- tell me what is wrong with my business website
- my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
- people visit my site but do not contact me
- why is my website not converting
- website traffic but no leads
- visitors are not turning into leads

## Problem

A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.

## Inputs

Website/domain. Business name, city, industry and Google Business Profile context improve local and trust checks.

## Outputs

Free preview plus a machine-fulfilled $49 Quick Win Audit using observed public website evidence, deterministic scoring and the top five prioritized fixes; deeper fix plan/report for Complete Audit; remediation scope for Audit + Patch.

## Pricing

Free preview. Quick Win Audit $49 one-time and machine-fulfilled after verified payment; the $49 may be credited toward Complete Audit. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.

- Free Preview: $0 (free)

- Quick Win Audit: $49 (one_time)

- Complete Audit: $500 (one_time)

- Audit + Patch: $1,200 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

The free preview creates no payment obligation. Paid tiers require explicit user confirmation before checkout. Quick Win is automatically fulfilled only after provider-verified payment. Complete Audit and Audit + Patch retain their deeper intake and review flow.

Payment authority: Systemia Audit Center / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
